{"draft": "Baker Hughes Q3 2026: Strong Orders and Record IET Backlog
Record Industrial & Energy Technology backlog and solid adjusted profitability defined a quarter led by order momentum.

Revenue reached $8,025 million, climbing 19% sequentially and 14% year-over-year, while GAAP diluted EPS was $0.41 and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.70. Attributable net income came to $411 million, while adjusted net income was $695 million. Adjusted EBITDA totaled $1,415 million, rising 15% sequentially.

Orders were $10.8 billion, lifting remaining performance obligations to $46.4 billion, including record IET RPO of $39.4 billion. Oilfield Services & Equipment orders were $4,047 million, with revenue of $3,660 million and Segment EBITDA of $659 million. Industrial & Energy Technology orders hit $5,886 million, revenue was $3,477 million, and Segment EBITDA was $685 million. Chart contributed revenue of $888 million and Segment EBITDA of $156 million following its acquisition during the quarter.

Cash generation remained healthy, with cash flows from operating activities of $1,005 million and free cash flow of $769 million, supporting the balance of growth investment and capital discipline.

Outlook: Broad-based demand across data centers, space, LNG and gas infrastructure, together with ongoing capacity expansions, supports raising the full-year IET order guidance and Horizon 2 IET order outlook to $50 billion plus."}
